propositions: CodeQL rule py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data reports 5 false-positive alerts flagging uses of audit logging in forced-write routes and CLI usage-error prints as sensitive-data leaks

Alert 86/87: the flagged expression joins detector family category names (e.g. 'GitHub token') drawn from the fixed SECRET_PATTERNS table, not credential values; SecretFinding structurally carries only family/field/line with no value field by design

Alerts 83/84/85: CodeQL taints argv remainder after stripping --allow-secret-pattern flag, but the flagged values are operator justifications not credentials, and the stripped flag token cannot reach the three downstream prints
Dismissal strategy: all 5 alerts dismissed via code-scanning API as false positives with evidence-backed justifications; no log-content change to preserve diagnostic value
Regression tests pin the invariant that secret values and override reasons never appear in forced-write audit logs or usage-error output, while detector families and argument names remain logged
